input.text: Dormant accounts are charged a maintenance fee of $5 per month. Classify accounts as dormant after 12 months without customer-initiated activity.

input.text: Regional managers may approve rate exceptions of up to 0.50%.

input.text: Outgoing consumer and small business wire requests received after 3:00 PM Central are processed the next business day. Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
